title: xAI and Grok: models, the SpaceX merger and the missing Grok 5
dek: Elon Musk's AI company shipped Grok 3 to Grok 4.7, merged into SpaceX and bought Cursor. Grok 5 has slipped past every promised date.
seoTitle: xAI Grok timeline 2025–2026: Grok 4.7, SpaceX, Grok 5
bigLabel: xAI's current flagship, released 21 Sep 2026; Grok 5 has no release date

glance.what: xAI released Grok 3 in February 2025 and Grok 4 in July 2025, then a run of Grok 4.x models through 2026. SpaceX acquired xAI in February 2026, and the company now uses SpaceX branding.
glance.why: Grok is built into X and Tesla products, and xAI's huge Colossus computers make it one of the few labs able to train the largest models.
glance.next: Grok 5: xAI said in January it was in training. Targets of late 2025, early 2026 and mid-2026 all passed; SpaceX has since pointed to before the end of 2026.

forYou: Grok is available in the X app and on its own app. New Grok versions usually reach paying X subscribers first.
next: Grok 5 release, targeted before the end of 2026.

events.title: Grok 3
events.summary: xAI releases Grok 3 and Grok 3 mini, trained with about ten times the computing power of Grok 2, according to xAI.

events.title: Grok 4 and Grok 4 Heavy
events.summary: Models with always-on reasoning and strong maths results.

events.title: Grok Code Fast 1
events.summary: A model built for coding agents.

events.title: Grok 4.1
events.summary: xAI says Grok 4.1 makes fewer factual errors.
events.differs: Sources give 17 or 19 November for the 4.1 versions.

events.title: 'Grok 5 is currently in training'
events.summary: xAI's Series E funding announcement says Grok 5 is being trained on its Colossus 2 cluster. It remains xAI's only official statement on the model.
events.differs: Sources date the announcement 6 January or 28 January.

events.title: SpaceX acquires xAI
events.summary: SpaceX buys xAI in a deal CNBC reports valued xAI at about $250 bn and the combined company at about $1.25 tn.

events.title: Grok 4.3
events.summary: A low-cost model with a 1-million-token context, on the API from 30 April after a beta.

events.title: Grok 4.5, Cursor deal and Grok 4.6
events.summary: Grok 4.5, a coding-focused model trained with Cursor, arrives in July; xAI's purchase of Cursor closes on 14 August; Grok 4.6 follows on 12 August.
events.differs: Sources give 8 July or 16 July for Grok 4.5.

events.title: Grok 4.7, the current flagship
events.summary: A larger base model with a 500,000-token context at $2/$6 per million tokens. Musk says Grok 4.8 and 4.9 will come before Grok 5.

events.title: Named in AI freeze lawsuit
events.summary: xAI, now SpaceX's AI arm (named in court papers as SpaceXSI), is one of five companies sued by nonprofits seeking to halt more capable AI.
